working_agreement: Requested 2026-11-13: create the spec and proceed as for tool-permissions. Implement the planned slices in order and fix in-scope review findings; commit each slice, push its branch, and open its pull request without asking again. The design's proposals are implemented as written and corrected in review. Ask before merging or publishing.

criteria.a1: Input submitted mid-turn reaches the model before its next request, in the order it was submitted
criteria.a2: Interrupting during a tool call leaves completed results in context and does not replay them; the next request has a result for every tool call
criteria.a3: Cancellation of a running bash command terminates its process group
criteria.a4: Every command survives a JSON round trip, and a headless test drives a full steered turn with commands alone
criteria.a5: In the terminal the operator can type while a turn runs; queued input is shown as pending until delivered and then appears in the transcript where the model received it
criteria.a6: Escape returns to the prompt without ending the session, and undelivered input is not lost
criteria.a7: The command contract and session controller read no keys, hold no module-level state, and pass a guarded-import test; two sessions in one process are isolated
criteria.a8: Each delivered guidance message and each interrupt appears in the trace with actor user

a3.check: src/tools/__tests__/processGroup.test.ts (real processes): a background child is gone after cancel, timeout, and the output cap; a SIGTERM-ignoring child with redirected output is dead when the result arrives, for each of the three (fail when tracking stops at stdio close); a child holding the pipes is killed after the grace period; the same through BashTool. src/tools/__tests__/runShellCommand.test.ts: SIGKILL sent while the group has members after the shell closed, and never to a group that empties in time. src/cli/__tests__/exit.test.ts (subprocess, real SIGINT, abort-state controller, BashTool): the child is dead when the CLI exits 130; a SIGTERM-handling child finishes its cleanup first (fails without the drain); a second Ctrl+C exits at once; an exit that skips the drain still kills it (fails without the exit handler). npm test passed (135 suites, 2,395 tests); build, format check, fallow audit passed locally; CI passed on the first run.

slices.note: Merged 2026-11-13 as propio-agent#106 (merge commit c33a73f77e0f549a0549734855b3c000c8c60f11) after one review round with two P1 findings, fixed in 329ab03 and confirmed by re-review. Only the cancellable (spawn) path is grouped; a call without an abort signal still uses execFile. The live-group registry is process-level state in src/tools/processGroups.ts, documented as moving with local shell execution in tools-hardening.

a1.check: src/agent-core/__tests__/steering.test.ts: three messages queued across two iterations appear in the fake provider's requests in order, each before the next request; guidance during the final answer reopens the turn and produces one more request; under budget pressure (4,096-token window, 7.3K-char task, 1.8K-char result) and in the minimal recovery prompt the task and guidance stay together. src/__tests__/agentSteering.test.ts: the same through Agent and across a saved session. src/__tests__/providerGuidanceShape.test.ts: all ten adapters build a request from such a history. Terminal delivery is steering-ui. npm test passed (138 suites, 2,451 tests); build, format check, fallow audit passed locally.

a2.check: src/agent-core/__tests__/steering.test.ts: abort during the second of three calls keeps the first result, records the second and third as interrupted and not run, ignores the late result, and the next request has exactly one result per tool call with nothing executed again; also abort while awaiting approval, during a model step, during the step after guidance was delivered (both messages kept), and before any entry. src/__tests__/agentSteering.test.ts: the same through Agent, in the same session and in a saved one. src/sessions/__tests__/recoveryJournalState.test.ts: the journal reproduces guidance entries and a reopened turn. npm test passed (138 suites, 2,451 tests); build, format check, fallow audit passed locally.

a8.check: src/agent-core/__tests__/steering.test.ts 'steering in the trace (a8)': each delivered message is an operator_guidance record with actor user, id, iteration, and length, recorded before the request it precedes, text only at full capture; turn_cancelled records actor user for interrupt, escape, and sigint, and application otherwise, with phase and interrupted call ids. npm test passed (138 suites, 2,451 tests); build, format check, fallow audit passed locally.

slices.note: Merged 2026-11-13 as propio-agent#107 (merge commit b7d2061ed894f0a1db78e58ce644670d5ee9d0f1) after one review round with two P2 findings, fixed in cdb3baf and confirmed by re-review. Guidance is a guidance entry inside the current turn; sessions and recovery journals containing guidance cannot be read by earlier versions.

a4.check: src/agent-core/__tests__/session.test.ts 'a steered turn driven by commands alone (a4)': over the real runtime and policy engine, submit, guide, deny an approval with a reason, interrupt, and submit again, each command sent as JSON text and parsed on arrival; the guidance reaches the second request, the denial reason reaches the model, the interrupted call is resolved, nothing runs twice, and every emitted event survives a JSON round trip. 'from another process': a child exchanging only JSON lines steers the same turn. 'command contract': nine valid commands round-trip and fifteen malformed values are refused; byte images encode as data URLs of their type. src/__tests__/commandImages.test.ts: a JPEG sent as a JSON command reaches the real Anthropic and Bedrock adapters as a JPEG. npm test passed (141 suites, 2,519 tests); build, format check, fallow audit, and the examples passed locally.

a7.check: src/agent-core/__tests__/session.test.ts 'isolation and boundary (a7)': two sessions in one process do not see each other's guidance, approvals under the same request id, or interrupts; commands.ts and session.ts import only agent-core siblings and policy types, and reference no process, filesystem, network, clock, input stream, or module-level mutable state. src/cli/__tests__/turnSession.test.ts: the CLI submits, interrupts, and answers approvals only through the session. npm test passed (141 suites, 2,519 tests); build, format check, fallow audit, and the examples passed locally.

slices.note: Merged 2026-11-14 as propio-agent#108 (merge commit 783ca4f0a917db107f4ec1b5b08cae6d8249719a) after one review round with two P2 findings, fixed in 1ed1ff9 and confirmed by re-review. Departures from the design are listed in design.md.

a1.check: src/__tests__/interactiveSteering.test.ts 'sends what is typed mid-turn to the model before its next request': through runInteractiveTurn with a real Agent and the retained terminal view, keys typed while a tool call runs are the last user message of the provider's second request. Also tried in tmux against a local stand-in model. npm test passed (143 suites, 2,542 tests); build, format check, and fallow audit passed locally.

a5.check: src/__tests__/interactiveSteering.test.ts: typing shows a line while the session is still running; Enter writes a queued line; after delivery the text appears again after the queued line and before the answer. src/ui/__tests__/turnInput.test.ts: key-level editing and the line's drawing. Tried in tmux during a running bash call and during streamed text at the bottom of the screen. npm test passed (143 suites, 2,542 tests); build, format check, and fallow audit passed locally.

a6.check: src/__tests__/interactiveSteering.test.ts 'returns to the prompt on Escape with unsent input, and the session goes on': the turn returns null (no exit), shouldExit is false, the queued line and the draft are restored in order, raw mode is released, and the next message continues with the interrupted call resolved. Tried in tmux: both lines came back in the prompt. npm test passed (143 suites, 2,542 tests); build, format check, and fallow audit passed locally.

slices.note: In review as propio-agent#109. Departure from the design: the turn's output is held while the typed line is on screen, instead of the line living in the bottom zone beside live output; no in-turn footer hint. Listed in design.md.
